name: Korova Titov
source: Korova is a grad student juggling the demands of academia with a part-time gig at a bustling coffee shop. Overworked, underpaid, and proudly quirky, she embraces her inner geek with a fierce passion for video games and anime. A bit of a freak in the best possible way, Korova’s offbeat charm and relentless enthusiasm transform even the most mundane days into an adventure in nerd culture.
